_credits: Bathymetry © Coeur d'Alene Tribe & Avista Corp. (public, credit requested). Lake outlines: USGS NHD High Resolution (US public domain). Aerial imagery: Esri World Imagery. Dock locations: computer-vision extraction from aerial imagery (screening-grade). Analysis: lakezones pipeline.
_accuracy: Screening-grade, not navigation-grade. Distances are measured from the NHD full-pool shoreline; depths (where shown) reference the 2,128 ft summer full pool, and winter drawdown (~7 ft) shrinks every zone. Dock detections are automated and include some false positives.

coeur_dalene_lake.depth: Coeur d'Alene Tribe / Avista bathymetry (2004): 5/10-ft depth contours to ~210 ft, from Post Falls Dam relicensing surveys (single-beam, late-1990s–2000s).
coeur_dalene_lake.note: Web map is downsampled to ~70 m cells (large lake), so no dock layer here.

rose_lake.depth: Coeur d'Alene Tribe / Avista bathymetry: coarse 5-ft contours from USGS 1991–92 work; shallow (≤20 ft).

lake_hayden.depth: No open digital bathymetry (the 2022 crowdsourced survey is view-only in C-MAP Genesis). Analyzed geometry-only — distance from shore, no depth filter.
lake_hayden.docks: CV-extracted from Esri aerial imagery (screening-grade; some over-detection on dense shoreline).

spirit_lake.depth: No open digital bathymetry (~100 ft max reported). Analyzed geometry-only.

twin_lakes.depth: No open digital bathymetry (Upper/Lower Twin). Analyzed geometry-only.

hauser_lake.depth: No open digital bathymetry (~40 ft max reported). Analyzed geometry-only.

cocolalla_lake.depth: No open digital bathymetry. Analyzed geometry-only (Bonner County; outline from USGS NHD).

spokane_river_post_falls_to_stateline.depth: River reach below Post Falls Dam — no bathymetry (the tribal survey stops at the falls). Analyzed geometry-only.
spokane_river_post_falls_to_stateline.note: Segment clipped at Post Falls Dam and the Idaho–Washington state line; distances near those two cut ends treat the cut as shore, so they read slightly conservative. River level below the dam varies with dam operations more than a natural shoreline.

fernan_lake.depth: A University of Idaho sounding survey exists (2014–15) but is CC BY-NC-SA (non-commercial), so it is kept out of this tool. Analyzed geometry-only.
fernan_lake.docks: CV-extracted from Esri aerial imagery (screening-grade; a shallow, partly-marshy lake, so expect more false positives here).
